
DESCRIPTION
Run mise commands using the runtime managed by One

USAGE
  one mise [args...] [flags]

EXAMPLES
  one mise trust
  one mise doctor
  one mise exec -- pnpm install

TIPS
Optional access to mise for configuration trust, diagnostics, and tool installation. One includes a pinned mise runtime and extracts it locally on first use without downloading mise. Arguments and output are passed through; project environment secrets are not loaded by One here. Normal development continues to use one dev and one run.

COMMON OPTIONS
  -o, --output <value>     Output format: json | yaml | text (default: terminal-friendly text, JSON when piped)
